content.short: Helping everyone discover why Cardano is a blockchain they should know all about.
content.description:
Blockchains are a crazy space for someone new to come into. The Digital Cash website was created to help anyone new wanting to discover why Cardano is a blockchain they should know all about. Starting out at a point of assuming no knowledge of what Cardano or even blockchain is, we debunk some of the myths about “all” blockchains, explain why Cardano is different and then delve into why it’s a blockchain you will really want to know all about.

Many people have heard terrible things about blockchains and as a result, have assumed anything to do with them is bad. Those of us on the inside of the Cardano community know that these things only apply to “some” blockchains. However, communicating that to the general public who’ve been force-fed the bad side of blockchain by the media is a challenge. This is due in a large part to the highly technical nature of blockchain.

The Digital Cash website was created to take on this challenge and to try and find a way to show many of the brilliant things about the good blockchains and in particular Cardano, that are going to change many people's lives for the better.
